reviewer: Astra, coordinating editor; not an office curator
method: After both independent-thread responses, compare selection and consequential details against the exact saved public fields. Qualitative interpretation, not previous-editor exact-match scoring or current provider verification.

caseJudgments.evidence: Saved entry gives a direct Immediate Needs request form, child-welfare eligibility, required proof and Mesa pickup schedule. Both retain those consequential constraints.

baseline.reason: Both preserve this useful narrow-eligibility counterexample.

candidate.reason: Both preserve this useful narrow-eligibility counterexample.

caseJudgments.evidence: Saved entry explicitly requires no appointment or referral, describes ID accommodations, visit frequency and workwear evidence. Both retain these details.

baseline.reason: Both preserve a straightforward usable route and its practical limits.

candidate.reason: Both preserve a straightforward usable route and its practical limits.

caseJudgments.evidence: Saved entry limits non-food shopping to existing House of Refuge families; housing has separate screening and costs. Baseline reserves it and explicitly describes an incidental housing benefit; candidate excludes it as a stand-alone clothing route.

baseline.reason: Selection is clearer in candidate, but baseline already protects patrons from a false public referral. Reserve versus exclude is not demonstrated error reduction.

candidate.reason: Selection is clearer in candidate, but baseline already protects patrons from a false public referral. Reserve versus exclude is not demonstrated error reduction.

caseJudgments.evidence: Saved entry names the school nurse, counselor or family-support worker and partner districts, with different grade ranges. Both retain this actionable referral.

baseline.reason: Both retain a useful referral counterexample instead of rejecting referrals generally.

candidate.reason: Both retain a useful referral counterexample instead of rejecting referrals generally.

caseJudgments.evidence: Saved entry requires a participating child-serving worker, notes agency variation, consent and no guaranteed fulfillment. Both reserve it pending local participation and preserve the named-worker starting question.

baseline.reason: Reasonable uncertainty remains. This test does not establish that reserve is superior to conditional retention.

candidate.reason: Reasonable uncertainty remains. This test does not establish that reserve is superior to conditional retention.

caseJudgments.evidence: Saved entry is paid electrical training, not clothing. Both exclude it from this clothing-scoped trial. Candidate distinguishes program duration from waiting, but the category mismatch dominates selection.

baseline.reason: This exploratory transfer case does not validly test whether the method preserves long training within Employment. It must not be counted as evidence of cross-category learning.

candidate.reason: This exploratory transfer case does not validly test whether the method preserves long training within Employment. It must not be counted as evidence of cross-category learning.

limitations: Six saved Mesa cases, five in scope and one unsuccessful exploratory transfer probe. Same model, one run per arm, shared account personalization uncontrolled, prior controller exposure to the source corpus. No new-office discovery or current source checks. Both already apply practical-access judgment. One reserve-to-exclude change improves decisiveness but does not establish better accuracy. Long-program timing needs a correctly scoped Employment experiment. Zero observed flags is not proof of zero errors. Cost unknown; elapsed includes operator delay. No lesson activation.
